The '''Vannell sector''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="EAOC" /> beyond the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="CSWE" /> A [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Vannell system|same name]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> lay within the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pollillus/Legends|Pollillus]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vannell sector was first mentioned in an entry for Pollillus in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Vannell system in grid square J-10.<ref name="TEA" />
